title: Your $100 Is Now Worth $12. Here's Where It Went (Inflation Explained)
description:
In 1970, $100 under a mattress would buy only about $12 worth of stuff today. So where did the other $88 go?

Penny the coin explains inflation with real government data: how prices are measured, what bread, eggs, coffee and gas cost in 1980 vs today, why prices rise, how the Fed fights back with interest rates, why the target is 2% instead of zero, who wins and who loses, why your pay barely beat inflation since 1973, and the rule of 70.
